title: Laredo Marathon Draws Record 700-Plus Runners; Ortiz and Rivera Take Top Honors
excerpt: More than 700 runners took part in the Laredo Marathon on Sunday, Nov. 15, a record turnout, with Rene Ortiz winning the men's full marathon in 2:26:50 and Anahi Rivera winning the women's race in 3:00:05, according to the Laredo Morning Times.
content:
More than 700 runners took part in the Laredo Marathon on Sunday, Nov. 15, a record turnout for the event, according to the Laredo Morning Times.

Rene Ortiz won the men's full marathon with a gun time of 2:26:50, followed by Corbin Harris in 2:31:35 and Eric Pineda in 2:38:08, according to the report.

Anahi Rivera won the women's full marathon in 3:00:05, followed by Anniejoy Amuan in 3:30:02 and Irma Cortez in 3:50:54, according to the report.

The full marathon started at Uni-Trade Stadium and finished in the parking lot of The Outlet Shoppes at Laredo, passing through different parts of the city, according to the report. The half marathon started at the Laredo Country Club and followed its own course. The event also included a five-person relay.

Results were divided by gender into age groups from 16-19 through 75-79, and full results are available at laredomarathon.com, according to the report. Participants ran for reasons including personal records, Boston Marathon qualifying and personal challenge.

Sources: Laredo Morning Times, Nov. 17, 2026.
